opennyai_summary.arguments:
Counsel for the State is present and submits that the present Writ petition has been filed for the payment of compensation under new law, as mentioned under Section 40(2) of the new act i.e. "The Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013".
Counsel submits that the acquisition has been initiated under the old Act i.e. "The Land Acquisition Act, 1894" and award has been prepared on 30.07.2013, whereas, the date of implementation of new law in Bihar is 01.01.2014.
opennyai_summary.decision:
The stand of the State is that since award was published on 01.07.2013, therefore, petitioner is entitled to receive compensation according to the old Act and not according to the new Act.
As a matter of last indulgence, one last opportunity is hereby granted.
If no one shall appears on the next date fixed then appropriate order shall be passed.
